text:
sarah: Quick review ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/428 adds NAT Gateway autoscaling for GPU VPCs (Terraform). Goal: reduce long-lived EIPs and allow scale-to-zero for dev/staging GPU pools. Requesting 1 infra + 1 SRE review before I flip the feature flag.

matt: Looking now. Quick question — how are existing EIPs handled during rollout? do we migrate or orphan?

sarah: Good call. I added a migration plan in the PR description: we tag current EIPs, run a one-time `terraform state mv` for resources we keep, then run a cleanup job that deletes unattached EIPs after 7 days. Short snippet in PR:
```bash
# list EIPs for the GPU VPC
aws ec2 describe-addresses --filters "Name=tag:VPC,Values=gpu-vpc"
```

matt: OK that helps. also, routing updates — does scale-to-zero remove the NAT target from route tables? need to ensure fallback to regional NAT if set.

olga: Skimmed the TF diff. Mostly good. Two asks before approval: 1) add a smoke test entry (how to verify NAT created/destroyed, sample `aws` commands), 2) add a short rollout window recommendation in the PR description (low traffic hours). Can you add both? :+1:

jon: Cost question — autoscaling looks like it will reduce hourly EIP charges, but do we have a rough estimate of transient costs for cold starts (creating a NAT GW costs, and there are per-hour charges once created)? even a back-of-envelope helps for the finance folks.

sarah: Added estimated numbers in PR: ~0.045 USD per NAT creation event + ~0.045/hr per NAT GW in us-west-2. For our dev/staging pools we estimate ~30-40 USD/month savings. I tagged finance to confirm. Also included a canary plan (scale subset to zero, then bring back 1 node).

deploy-bot: buildkite:infra-nat-autoscale #1284 — plan succeeded. plan summary: 0 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy. (link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/builds/1284)

matt: Approved. will defer final merge to SRE signoff on canaries.

olga: Approved after smoke steps added. :shipit:

sarah: Thanks! I'll wait for SRE and then merge at 10:00am PT tomorrow if no blockers. I'll create a follow-up runbook entry and smoke-test checklist in Confluence and paste it here when done.
